title: Formula width criterion
statement: Let a disjunctive normal form formula be a finite list of terms, each a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates, and let its width be the maximum term width (or zero for an empty list). Its width is at most $w$ if and only if every term in the formula has width at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on n coordinates
